settings.question: How do I get started?
settings.answer: Call us at (302) 608-3780 or use our contact form. We typically respond within 24–48 hours.

settings.question: Do you accept insurance?
settings.answer: We can review insurance, out-of-network benefits, and self-pay options with you before scheduling.

settings.question: How do I know if this is the right fit?
settings.answer: Our first conversation helps us understand your goals and determine whether this service is right for you, or offer a referral if another setting would serve you better.
